system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
I've been trying to select "no" for this option multiple times but every time after closing the settings, it goes right back to "minimized." I do not want this to boot up at startup. What gives? <link>

PREDICTED INTENT: other

PRECEDENTS:

[2240448] (similarity 0.54, intent other)
  past customer: how can I save the settings in your Mac App? I would like to disable the auto startup "feature", but I just won't save the setting. Thx in advance
  spotify replied: Hi there. Can you let us know what device, OS X, and Spotify versions you're running? We'll see what we can suggest

[181683] (similarity 0.51, intent other)
  past customer: how can I stop your mac app from launching at startup? And why does it do so by default?
  spotify replied: Hey Joss! Just to check, have you disabled "Open Spotify automatically adter you log into the computer" through the desktop app's Settings? It's under "Startup and Window Behaviour"

[783496] (similarity 0.49, intent other)
  past customer: Why is starting up when launching my pc, even when I turned that off?
  spotify replied: Hi Ramon, help's here! Can you let us know your desktop's OS and Spotify versions? We'll see what we can suggest

[306144] (similarity 0.43, intent other)
  past customer: I don't want Spotify to load when I start up my computer. I changed the setting in settings but it still loads (Windows 10). I want to use Spotify but want to control when. Am a Groove user and will pay for premium if I can stop it.
  spotify replied: Hi Stephen! Can you let us know the exact Spotify version you're using? Did this happen after an update? We'll see what we can suggest

[937028] (similarity 0.41, intent other)
  past customer: I would swear that y'all keep turning the "Autoplay" feature back on whenever I turn it off. Is that true?
  spotify replied: Hey! AutoPlay shouldn't turn back on if you've already switched it off. What device, OS, and Spotify version are you using?

Draft the reply as JSON.
